title: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Mojito Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Mojito blends juicy Strawberry with sharp Lime and cool Mint for a fresh, cocktail-inspired vape. The Strawberry note adds ripe sweetness, balanced by zesty citrus and a clean Mint layer that gives the flavour a bright, refreshing lift. Formulated with nicotine salts for faster nicotine delivery and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. The 50VG/50PG blend ensures discreet vapour and consistently clear flavour. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
